topic: The August IMI instalment closes on the 31st

frames.headline: If you pay IMI in instalments, one is due this month.

frames.label: This instalment closes
frames.body: Miss it and the whole remaining bill can fall due at once, not just the instalment.

frames.label: Instalments, not two
frames.body: Larger bills are split across May, August and November. The August one is the middle payment people forget.

frames.headline: Check your IMI notice before the 31st.
frames.action: Open Portal das Financas and confirm which instalment plan you are on.
